revision.description: Settings revision, incremented by every write; a change against an older revision is refused with conflict.

integrations.description: The project's integration variant and credential; absent: the machine's provider defaults, then the derived variant.

model.description: The project's model language: same (the interface language) or a locale; absent: the machine's language.model.

format.description: The form of a diagram in text a model writes for a human (the writing skill): text, a fixed-width text diagram, or mermaid, a fenced Mermaid block; absent: the machine's diagrams.format.

plan_defaults.description: The project's method and asking axes and its posture; absent: the machine's plan_defaults.

asking.description: Which phase transitions wait for the operator, among them the outline review and whether a plan stops before its merge (Plan Behaviour Axes).

posture.description: The project's execution posture; absent: the machine's plan_defaults.posture, and while that is absent too, asked in init.options of every plan (Workflow DSL Specification, Posture and base branch).

cleanup.description: The project's own cleanup durations of its plans, epics, and logs; absent: the machine's (Timeouts & Budgets Specification, One Cleanup).

upstream_mcp.description: Upstream MCP allowlist of the project (PM-SVC-3); written only on pm-operator upstream allow|deny; absent means no upstream server.

url.description: Remote HTTPS endpoint of the upstream server, called through cui-http; the only transport.

credential_key.description: Present for an authenticated server and then equal to mcp-<server_id> (identifiers.adoc, credential_key); absent: the server is called without a credential.

tools.description: The upstream tools the server may call; a tool not listed is not reachable.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: timeouts.adoc, Outbound HTTPS and upstream MCP call timeouts.

read_timeout_seconds.description: timeouts.adoc, Outbound HTTPS and upstream MCP call timeouts.

integration_provenance.description: The snippet provenance provider of this project (Job Runtime Specification, Snippet Provenance Provider); present only after the operator's act that showed what leaves the machine. No machine default exists.

credential_key.description: null for a service on the operator's own network that takes no credential.

commit_identity.description: Author of server commits (the operator); the committer is resolved from the agent credential.

epic.description: Values a new epic takes into its header (Store Schemas, Epic Header); never asked at an epic's start.

auto_start.description: Whether the epic starts its launchable rows by itself (Model Work Specification, An Epic Runs by Itself).

overlap_max_files.description: Files a launchable row may share with a running plan of the epic before it waits with reason overlap; the maximum is the compiled upper bound.

parallelization_scope.description: Upper limit of an epic's running plans; raised by the operator through the epic's next plan or the project's settings.

qualification.description: The operator's level for role qualification (PM-WORK-6; Task Queue & Qualification Records, Role Qualification Record).

agreement_level.description: Percent of the items of each topic of a role (its own items and the generic items; review status draft or confirmed) a configuration must answer right in every topic; read at every validity check, so a changed level applies to existing records.

allowed_gap.description: Largest allowed warm-fresh gap in percentage points for the warm form; read at every validity check.

skip_roles.description: Roles the setup run does not grade (setup.probe-qualification); such a role stays unqualified unless a valid record exists. Names roles only; the quorum calibration has its own key skip_decisions.

skip_decisions.description: When true the setup run does not calibrate the quorum declarations of the adjudication unit (setup.probe-qualification); a quorum declaration without a valid calibration record does not decide, and its decisions are the operator's, in an operator wait.

commit_trailer.description: Co-Authored-By trailer of server commits; compiled default plan-marshall <noreply@cuioss.de>.

envelope_budget_tokens.description: Override of the per-envelope packing budget derived from the harness profile's context budget (compiled fallback 400000).

derivation_resolvers.description: Axis-C resolver enablement; an absent entry means enabled, only an explicit false disables a resolver. The resolver project-script has no entry: the enrolment of an edge_resolver project script is its enablement.

retention.description: Retention of technical residue in days, removed by the periodic sweep (timeouts.adoc, Retention & Rotation); work history is the cleanup's, never retention.

task_records_days.description: Age after which an ended queue task record, and the record of an ended job of the workspace scope or of a worker, is residue.

retired_lesson_bodies_days.description: Age after which the body of a retired lesson is residue, whatever the retirement's verdict; its front matter is kept.

arch_constraint_quiet_days.description: Quiet window of the arch-constraint retirement of pm-operator sweep --apply.

workspace_rows_days.description: Age after which closed or ended technical rows of the workspace scope's stores are residue (Evidence-Based Removal Sweeps); never the metrics rows of a plan.
